segments.context: Onyx Coffee Lab · United StatesColombia Aponte Village Honey (2026 whole bean)The 2026 Aponte Village Honey is a good small-bag trial for a buyer who wants a fruit-forward Colombian coffee with a documented red-honey process and separate filter and espresso starts. Onyx describes an Inga community field blend from Nariño and gives an Origami/Kalita 25:400 brew plus a 20:48 espresso target. Honeycrisp apple, cherry, vanilla and papaya are roaster notes; Coffeedant has not tasted the bag. Fellow's 2026 Advent guide independently supplies a smaller Stagg X start. The current page has contradictory caffeine metadata, so no caffeine claim is made. Check the exact 2026 whole-bean listing and delivered pack before ordering bulk.Updated 2026-11-12 · Check the current US whole-bean checkout total at November 12, 2026
